description.narrative: Intermational Disability Alliance is a global network of disabled persons organisations working for implementation of UN convention for the rights of persons with disability.

International Disability Alliance (IDA) är ett globalt nätverk av regional organisationer för personer med funktionsnedsättning som verkar för ratificering och implementering av FN's konvention om rättigheter för personer med funktionsnedsättning.

General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2015Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: IDA has continued to work for a new enabling environment for the implementation of the CRPD and inclusive development. The work has in 2015 centred around the development of the SDG-process where IDA has taken a very active role and also succeeded to contributing to the inclusion of personas with disabilities in the SDGs. The 2030 agenda is recognizant of persons with disabilities as key stakeholders in the sustainable development process. In addition IDA has continued to advocate for the rights of person with disabilities within the UN system primarily. They have succeeded to make submission and various recommendations have been adopted by the various UN entities. Capacity Building efforts has also been conducted during the period to member organisations. Important to follow up on the various evaluation recommendations. Traning on IDA partners has been central to increase the capacity of the members in order to conduct the advocacy work on the international, regional and national.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
